a.lede: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.
a.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions

b.lede: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
b.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
